title: Finite-type realization of a relatively very ample invertible module over a qcqs base
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with $S$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $N$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] which is relatively very ample over $S$ [def-trf-relatively-very-ample]. Then there exist a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module $E$ of finite type [pqf-def-coherent] and an immersion $r:X\to\mathbf P_S(E)$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] over $S$ such that $r^*\mathcal O_{\mathbf P_S(E)}(1)\cong N$. Here $\pi_E:\mathbf P_S(E)\to S$ is the projective-bundle structure morphism [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism], being over $S$ means $\pi_E\circ r=f$, the degree-one twist is the canonical invertible module with its tautological quotient [lem-trf-projective-bundle-quotient-geometry], and $r^*$ is tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. No properness hypothesis on $f$ and no local-freeness hypothesis on $E$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 07RM (lemma-quasi-projective-open-projective), proof after replacing the relatively ample module by a relatively very ample power: finite-type approximation of f_*N, simultaneous lifting of the finite affine-local sets of immersion sections, and the resulting immersion r_{N,psi_i}. The construction pulls the canonical degree-one twist back to N.

proof.text: Since $f$ is of finite type it is quasi-compact by [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Apply the final, independent clause of [lem-trf-relative-ample-very-ample] to the quasi-compact morphism $f$ and the relatively very ample $N$: it gives quasi-separatedness of $f$. Invertibility makes $N$ quasi-coherent by [def-sc-invertible-module]. Therefore [pqf-lem-pushforward-qcoh] gives a quasi-coherent module $F=f_*N$ on $S$.

source.place: 07RM, lemma-quasi-projective-open-projective, paragraph defining F; 01VR, lemma-relatively-very-ample, final evaluation clause; Schemes 01LC, lemma-push-forward-quasi-coherent

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-directed-colimit-finite-presentation] to the quasi-coherent $F$ on the assumed qcqs scheme $S$. Obtain a nonempty directed set $I$, finitely presented modules $E_i$, maps $c_i:E_i\to F$, and $F=\varinjlim_i E_i$. Each $E_i$ is quasi-coherent by clause (0) of [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine]. It is of finite type: the local presentation $\mathcal O^{m}\to\mathcal O^{n}\to E_i\to0$ includes a surjection $\mathcal O^n\twoheadrightarrow E_i$, precisely the finite-type condition in [pqf-def-coherent].

source.place: 01PK, lemma-directed-colimit-finite-presentation; Modules 01BO, lemma-finite-presentation-quasi-coherent; the approximation paragraph of 07RM

proof.text: Choose a finite affine open covering $S=\bigcup_{j=1}^{m}V_j$ by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-finite-affine-open-cover], and put $X_j=f^{-1}V_j$ and $N_j=N|_{X_j}$. The restriction $f_j:X_j\to V_j$ is of finite type directly from the affine-local definition in [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Restrict a witness for [def-trf-relatively-very-ample] to $V_j$: its immersion remains an immersion by [lem-weil-pbc-immersion-base-change-lft], its projective bundle and twist restrict as in [lem-trf-projective-bundle-quotient-geometry], and tensor pullback composes as in [def-pc-module-pullback]. Thus $N_j$ is relatively very ample over $V_j$.

source.place: 07RM, choice of a finite affine cover; restriction of the defining witness of 01VM

proof.text: For each $j$ apply [lem-sfb-very-ample-affine-finite-sections] to $f_j$ and $N_j$. It gives finitely many generating sections $s_{j,0},\ldots,s_{j,n_j}$ and their quotient-classified immersion $a_j:X_j\to\mathbf P^{n_j}_{V_j}$. Regard these sections as elements of $F(V_j)=\Gamma(X_j,N_j)$, the definition of pushforward in [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction].

For every pair $(j,t)$, [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-colimit-affine-sections] lifts $s_{j,t}\in F(V_j)$ to some $e'_{j,t}\in E_{i(j,t)}(V_j)$, since $V_j$ is affine and all stages are quasi-coherent. There are only finitely many such pairs. Starting with any index of the nonempty $I$, successively take upper bounds with the finitely many $i(j,t)$; obtain one index $i$ above them all. Transport $e'_{j,t}$ along the transition maps to $e_{j,t}\in E_i(V_j)$. The cocone identity gives $c_i(e_{j,t})=s_{j,t}$ for every $0\le t\le n_j$. Write $E=E_i$ and $c=c_i$.

source.place: 07RM, simultaneous lifting of all the finite section families to a common stage

proof.text: Let $\psi:f^*E\to N$ be the adjoint of $c:E\to f_*N$ under [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. In the tensor description its local rule is $a\otimes e\mapsto a\,c(e)$, so on $X_j$ it sends $1\otimes e_{j,t}$ to $s_{j,t}$. These sections generate $N_j$; hence at every stalk of $X_j$ the image of $\psi$ is all of the stalk of $N$. The $X_j$ cover $X$, so $\psi$ is surjective. By [lem-trf-projective-bundle-quotient-geometry] this quotient defines an $S$-morphism $r:X\to P=\mathbf P_S(E)$ with $\pi_E r=f$ and a quotient-compatible isomorphism $r^*\mathcal O_P(1)\cong N$.

source.place: 07RM, surjectivity of psi_i and construction of r_{L,psi_i}; Constructions 01OA quotient-functor description

proof.text: For each $j$, put $P_j=P\times_SV_j=\mathbf P_{V_j}(E|_{V_j})$, with projection $p_j$ and tautological quotient $u_j:p_j^*(E|_{V_j})\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal O_{P_j}(1)$ from [lem-trf-projective-bundle-quotient-geometry]. The sections $e_{j,t}$ define $b_j:\mathcal O_{V_j}^{n_j+1}\to E|_{V_j}$. Let $W_j\subseteq P_j$ be the locus where $u_jp_j^*b_j$ is surjective. This is open: on a trivialization of the invertible target, write the images of the finitely many basis vectors as functions $h_t$; the locus is $\bigcup_tD(h_t)$. Changing the trivialization multiplies all $h_t$ by a unit, so these opens agree. On $W_j$ the quotient bijection in the same cited node gives $\beta_j:W_j\to\mathbf P^{n_j}_{V_j}$. This constructs the intermediate projection only on its actual domain of definition.

source.place: 07RM, the local factorization through P(E_i)|V_j, with the implicit open domain of its rational projection written out

proof.text: The quotient-compatible isomorphism for $r$ and the equalities $c(e_{j,t})=s_{j,t}$ show that the pullback of $u_jp_j^*b_j$ along $r|_{X_j}$ is the surjection with coordinates $s_{j,t}$. Consequently $r(X_j)\subseteq W_j$. Moreover $r^{-1}(W_j)=X_j$, since $W_j$ lies over $V_j$. Naturality and injectivity of the quotient classification in [lem-trf-projective-bundle-quotient-geometry] identify $\beta_j\circ(r|_{X_j})$ with $a_j$: both classify exactly that coordinate quotient onto $N_j$. Since $a_j$ is an immersion, [lem-zl-immersion-cancellation] makes $X_j\to W_j$ an immersion.

The $W_j$ are open in $P$, they cover $r(X)$, and $r^{-1}(W_j)\to W_j$ is an immersion for each $j$. Thus [lem-zl-immersion-near-image-locality] shows that $r:X\to P$ is an immersion. Together with the finite-type quasi-coherence of $E$ from step 2 and $r^*\mathcal O_P(1)\cong N$ from step 6 this proves every assertion. Empty covers cause no exception: if $S$ is empty then $X$ is empty, $I$ is still nonempty, and the image-cover criterion includes the empty family.

source.place: 07RM, conclusion that r_{L,psi_i} is an immersion; 0FCZ, lemma-check-immersion

lean.statement: theorem veryAmple_finiteType_realization {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] (N : X.Modules) [N.IsInvertible] (hN : IsRelativelyVeryAmple f N) : ∃ (E : S.Modules) (hE : E.IsQuasicoherent), E.IsFiniteType ∧ ∃ (D : @ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient S E hE) (r : X ⟶ (@SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData S E hE).relProj), IsImmersion r ∧ r ≫ (@SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData S E hE).relProjHom = f ∧ Nonempty ((tensorPullback r).obj D.line ≅ N)
